title: Exponents
preview: Properties of exponents and monomials: multiplying, dividing, raising to powers, and zero and negative exponents to simplify expressions.
description: Students build the exponent properties from patterns, then use them to multiply, divide, and raise monomials to powers, and extend the rules to zero and negative integer exponents — all in service of simplifying expressions.

sections.label: 1-1 Powers and Exponents
sections.description: Product, quotient, and power-of-a-power rules with whole-number exponents.

sections.label: 1-2 Multiply and Divide Monomials
sections.description: Apply the product and quotient rules to monomials with coefficients and variables.

sections.label: 1-3 Powers of Monomials
sections.description: Raise a monomial to a power: the exponent applies to the coefficient and the variable.

sections.label: 1-4 Zero and Negative Exponents
sections.description: Extend exponent rules to zero and negative integers to simplify expressions.

source.name: Plug N Play
source.attribution: Plug N Play. Module organisation aligned to Indiana grade-8 academic standards (exponent properties, 8.NS.3).
